about_the_game:
Reng Azure Requiem is a 2D Action-Adventure game that mixes Metroidvania and a Soulslike challenge in the non-linear world of Tartarius, where your choices define your final destiny.

Combat with Teleportation

  • 4-direction Teleportation replaces the traditional jump.

  • Wield the mystical blue sword with strategy.

Raven’s Power

  • Summon the Raven for combat or transform into it for exploration.

Progression and Choices

  • Gain XP by defeating enemies and collect experience grave markers.

  • Find Sacred Statues to spend your upgrade points.

  • 9 upgradeable abilities: damage, speed, teleport, resistance, shield, extra soul, and Raven powers.

  • Your upgrade choices shape your playstyle.

Metroidvania Exploration

  • The world is interconnected by portals for exploration and saving.

  • Each portal leads to a unique region that hides secrets, bosses, and unique challenges.

Soul Survival

  • Your soul weakens over time — warm yourself at Spiritual Bonfires.

Challenges and Objectives

  • Your choices between Combat and Redemption determine your path through the game's 4 main acts in the search for the soul's resurrection.

  • OS *: Windows 7 +

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 compatible

Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10

short_description: Wielding a mystical blue sword and the power of teleportation, evolve your 9 abilities and defy the Soul World in this 2D Action and Adventure game. Your choices will define your destiny between Conflict and Redemption.
